verdict_vs_market.quote: This is a solid, credible L6 offer—not an exceptional “leave a job you like” offer.

verdict_vs_current.quote: That is only a broad benchmark; **your actual Meta forward compensation is what matters**.

recommendation.quote: Negotiate. Don’t accept the initial offer as-is, but don’t walk away yet.

equity_grounding.quote: That is an assertive anchor, but not an absurd one for a currently employed Meta IC6 whom Google sourced.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Bay Area-specific Levels.fyi data reports an L6 median of approximately **$606,000**, although these datasets combine new hires and existing employees with stacked refresh grants

caveat_tenure_offering_company.quote: although these datasets combine new hires and existing employees with stacked refresh grants, making them imperfect offer benchmarks.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Value the offer using only the initial grant. Treat refreshers as upside—not as money already offered.

up_level_ask.quote: Is there any flexibility on level if your Meta scope supports L7 consideration?

level_claim.quote: Don’t jeopardize a confirmed L6 offer by insisting on L7, but if your current scope is genuinely cross-organizational and comparable to Google L7 PM work, it is worth asking

walkaway_tied_to.quote: If Google cannot meaningfully improve the offer, I would remain at Meta unless the Google role is substantially better for your career, work-life balance, or interests.

rsu_annualized.quote: Equity: Above the recent median when divided by four
